description: Source code implementing functions to insert references to interface block members at the start of the main function in shader code, working around driver issues on Mac. It manipulates AST nodes related to shader interface blocks.

methods.name: AddNodeUseStatements
methods.description: Recursively adds nodes or array elements to the sequence for referencing.

methods.name: AddFieldUseStatements
methods.description: Adds use statements for a shader variable to the sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode
methods.description: Inserts use code for an interface block into the sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode (overload)
methods.description: Inserts use code for all interface blocks into the sequence.

methods.name: UseInterfaceBlockFields
methods.description: Main function that inserts references to interface block members at the start of main and validates the AST.
